behavior: Read a bounded list of recent immutable purchase snapshots.

input.name: limit
input.constraint: application clamps to 1..100; HTTP has no limit parameter

sourceBinding.status: source-reconciled specification; no current runtime or compliance verdict

domainModelNotes: No Procurement domain-event object is emitted. GoodsReceived is a separate producer-owned integration contract on first receipt.
postconditions: Most recent created orders first; maximum 100.
SQL ordering is created_at DESC, id DESC; no pagination/cursor contract.
No supplier call or stock mutation.
